name: quandora
description: Quandora plugin with Factor Mining and Strategy Building skills.

interface.shortDescription: Use Quandora services from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Quandora packages Factor Mining and Strategy Building skills in one plugin. Factor Mining supports tasks, sessions, factor source submission, backtests, artifact retrieval, and result summaries; Strategy Building composes and resumes cross-sectional runs from existing factors.
defaultPrompt: Use Quandora Factor Mining to show public tasks.
Use Quandora Factor Mining with my custom factor idea.
Use Quandora Factor Mining to resume a run and summarize results.
Use Quandora Strategy to combine existing factors into a cross-sectional strategy.
